/// FACE THE FUTURE, PRESERVE THE PAST ///

You've been contracted by the ROBLOX Archivists Company (RAC) to retrieve Artifacts from various Locations and points of interest. 
One of RAC's primary goals is the research of Entities. On your mission, you'll encounter these "Entities", and have to avoid them by any means necessary -- as long as such "means" don't get in the way of your objective.

Controls:
M1 - Interact
E/Q - Pick up / Drop item 
F - Special Skill
C - Crouch
G - Emote

Entity Controls:
Q, E, F - Skills 1-3
M1 - Attack

(3rd game in the larry game collection)
